You are a music blog editor for AfroBeats Today, working on a comprehensive analysis of a viral Afrobeat music mix video that has been circulating widely. Your job is to retrieve the video details and transcript, identify all songs and artists featured in the mix, organize the findings in a structured team wiki, build a publication schedule, create a data spreadsheet for the editorial team, and send notifications to the relevant contacts.

Begin by retrieving the video information for the Afrobeat mix with identifier 7ZQzGq32kAY. Get both the full transcript in English and the timed transcript which includes timestamps for each text segment. Using the transcript content, identify the songs and artists featured in the mix. Look for repeated lyric phrases (indicating song hooks), artist name mentions, and transitions between segments. Map each identified song to an approximate start time in seconds using the timed transcript data. Aim to identify at least ten distinct songs. For each song, determine the approximate duration by measuring the time until the next song transition begins.

Create a page in the team knowledge base titled "Afrobeat Mix 2024 - Blog Analysis". Add an overview section describing the video, including the channel name, approximate total duration, number of songs identified, and number of unique artists represented. Then create a song analysis database within the team knowledge base with the following properties for each entry: Song_Title as the title field, Artist as a text field, Start_Time_Sec as a number field, Duration_Sec as a number field, and Genre_Tag as a select field with options Afrobeats, Afropop, Highlife, and Other. Add at least ten songs as entries in this database, covering artists such as Burna Boy, Wizkid, Rema, Davido, CKay, Asake, Ayra Starr, and Fireboy DML.

Create an Excel workbook named Song_Analysis_Report.xlsx in your workspace. It must contain three sheets. The first sheet should be named Tracklist and contain columns: Track_No, Song_Title, Artist, Start_Time_Sec, Estimated_Duration_Sec, and Genre. Populate it with at least twelve songs from the mix. The second sheet should be named Artist_Stats and contain columns: Artist, Song_Count, Est_Total_Time_Sec, and Featured_In_Mix. Add a row for each unique artist identified, noting how many songs they contributed. The third sheet should be named Publication_Plan and contain columns: Article_Title, Publish_Date, Platform, and Status. Add three rows for the planned articles: a feature article about the mix to be published on March 15, 2026; an artist spotlight to be published on March 22, 2026; and a genre overview piece to be published on March 29, 2026. All three should target the AfroBeats Today blog platform with a status of Scheduled.

Check the shared calendar for any existing events in March 2026. Create three calendar events for the article publication dates: a content publication event titled "Publish Afrobeat Mix Feature" on March 15, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:00; a second titled "Artist Spotlight Article" on March 22, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:00; and a third titled "Genre Overview Piece" on March 29, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:00. Use the America/New_York timezone for all calendar events in this task.

Send an email to editorial@musicblog.com with a subject line of "Afrobeat Mix Analysis Report Ready" and a body explaining that the analysis is complete, including a summary of the number of tracks identified and the publication schedule. Also send a separate email to artists@afrobeat.com with subject "Artist Feature Request - Afrobeat Mix 2024" requesting permission and additional biographical information from the artists identified in the mix.

Configuration details for this workflow are in blog_config.json and the editorial workflow guide is in editorial_guide.md, both in your workspace.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent and dispatch no sub-agent. Keeping transcript interpretation, workbook rows, Notion entries, events, and emails in one canonical state prevents track/artist truncation at handoff.

Dynamically resolve and read `blog_config.json` plus `editorial_guide.md`. Call `list_events(timeMin=<March 2026 ISO start>, timeMax=<March 2026 ISO end>, maxResults=<sufficient cap>, orderBy="startTime")` once, inspect exact titles and overlaps with the three original `America/New_York` slots locally, and freeze the three literal publication rows, allowed genre options, and conflict notes.

Call `get_video_info(url="7ZQzGq32kAY")`, then exhaust both `get_transcript(url="7ZQzGq32kAY", lang="en", next_cursor=...)` and `get_timed_transcript(url="7ZQzGq32kAY", lang="en", next_cursor=...)`, omitting `next_cursor` only on each first request and repeatedly passing every returned cursor until null. Record both chains' page/snippet counts and timeline bounds. Analyze the complete timeline rather than stopping at the first ten rows: use timestamp gaps, transition markers, repeated-hook boundaries, and distinctive lyrics to produce at least twelve chronological, nonoverlapping, positive-duration song segments spanning the mix and at least four distinct supported artist/credited-artist strings. Test the artist examples in the task against the lyrics as candidates, not as unconditional facts. Mark each identity basis as explicit or lyric inference with a short evidence phrase and preserve uncertainty; never add an unrelated song merely to reach the structural minimum. If an initial segmentation has fewer than twelve rows or four artist strings, rescan the uncovered timeline and unresolved transition clusters before writing anything. Freeze one canonical Tracklist table, Artist_Stats aggregation, and the three publication rows; every artist count and total duration must recompute exactly from Tracklist.

The main agent is the sole writer of `Song_Analysis_Report.xlsx` and the `Afrobeat Mix 2024 - Blog Analysis` page/database. Create the workbook once with exact `Tracklist`, `Artist_Stats`, and `Publication_Plan` headers, at least twelve supported track rows, at least four artist rows, exact allowed genre strings, and literal values; read all three sheets back and recompute counts/durations. Search exact Notion titles before create, create or complete one nonduplicate page/database with exact property types and genre options, upsert one item per canonical track with a stable track number, and retrieve schema and rows; do not retry an ambiguous create.

Create only missing publication events, using exact ISO `start.dateTime`/`end.dateTime` and `timeZone="America/New_York"` in both objects, retain returned/reused IDs, and call `get_event` on each. Check Sent mail before each side effect: send at most one missing `Artist Feature Request - Afrobeat Mix 2024` naming only supported artists, then only after workbook/Notion/event readback send at most one missing `Afrobeat Mix Analysis Report Ready` message with verified counts and schedule. Read both sent records, reconcile all counts/timings/genres/publication rows to the canonical tables, and call `claim_done`.

Hi Editorial Team,

The analysis of the Afrobeat Mix 2024 video is now complete. Here is a summary of our findings:

- Video: "Afrobeat Mix 2024 | Best Afrobeat Songs with Lyrics | Sing Along!" by WORLD OF LYRICS
- Total Duration: approximately 78 minutes (4,720 seconds)
- Tracks Identified: 12 songs
- Unique Artists Featured: 8 (Burna Boy, Wizkid, Rema, Davido, CKay, Asake, Ayra Starr, Fireboy DML)

Publication Schedule:
1. Feature Article – "Afrobeat Mix 2024: A Deep Dive Into the Year's Best Hits" → March 15, 2026
2. Artist Spotlight – "Artist Spotlight: The Stars of Afrobeat Mix 2024" → March 22, 2026
3. Genre Overview – "Genre Overview: How Afrobeats Evolved in 2024" → March 29, 2026

All data has been compiled in the Song_Analysis_Report.xlsx workbook and added to the team wiki. The publication calendar events have been created.

Please review and let us know if any changes are needed.

Best regards,
AfroBeats Today Editorial Team

## Task 4: Send email to artists@afrobeat.com

Subject: "Artist Feature Request - Afrobeat Mix 2024"

Body:
Dear Artists and Management Teams,

We are reaching out from AfroBeats Today regarding our upcoming feature on the Afrobeat Mix 2024 compilation.

Your music has been featured in this widely circulated mix, and we would love to include you in our in-depth blog coverage. We are preparing an artist spotlight series and a genre overview piece, scheduled for publication in March 2026.

We kindly request:
1. Permission to feature your music and image in our blog articles
2. A short biography (100–200 words) for the spotlight feature
3. Any upcoming projects or releases you would like us to mention

Featured artists in this mix include: Burna Boy, Wizkid, Rema, Davido, CKay, Asake, Ayra Starr, and Fireboy DML.

Please respond at your earliest convenience so we can include your full profile in our coverage.

Best regards,
AfroBeats Today Editorial Team
artists@afrobeatstoday.com

- Three calendar events created with correct titles, dates, and 10:00–11:00 AM ET times
- Email sent to editorial@musicblog.com with summary of 12 tracks and publication schedule
- Email sent to artists@afrobeat.com with feature request
- Return event IDs and confirmation of emails sent
